name: frame
title: App frame
description: Collapsible sidebar, sticky header with breadcrumb title and signed-in person, a status line, and an error boundary per screen. An app supplies its nav, and may group it under labels, give a record its own scoped nav with a way back, add an aside that persists across screens (a bottom bar and sheet on phones), and set the status line, header contents, widths and crumbs.
